The settlement will then be randomly placed on the map with that orientation. Via the 'castle' menu item, the player (as leader) can decide which [ buildings](help.php?m=buildings) to build or extend in this settlement. Some building levels and combinations activate more buildings options. ## Resources [ Resources and settlers](help.php?m=villages&sub=resources) are needed for this, whereby resources are used up for the building process and settlers are needed to carry out the process. There are three types of resources (stone, wood and ore) that are all automatically produced by the corresponding buildings. The total amount of available settlers will only change when the [ miller](help.php?m=buildings&sub=details&&build=farm) is extended. New settlers are not constantly produced. ## Trade Resources can be produced as well as [traded](help.php?m=player&sub=trade) via the [ market](help.php?m=buildings&sub=details&&build=market) building. Resources can be offered from the free market or directly swapped amongst players. In order to do this, you need donkeys, which can be bred at the [ donkey stable](help.php?m=buildings&sub=details&&build=stable) . ## Train After the first extension phase, the player gets access to the [ barracks](help.php?m=buildings&sub=details&&build=barracks) . This building enables the player to research the first military [ units](help.php?m=units) and train them. Units do not have any upkeep costs, but the unit amount is limited by the number of available settlers. If you fulfil particular requirements, more battle unit types can be researched. This means that you can then train more units of this type in the barracks. ## Conquer If a player survives the development phase, he is in the position to go to war with other players to **completely** take over their cities (so-called [ conquering](help.php?m=units&sub=conquer) ). In order to do this, the player needs a [ count](help.php?m=units&sub=snob) , which is a special military unit that has special requirements and is very expensive to produce. To train counts, you need to play for a longer amount of time and extend your city further. ## Attack protection **General protection** There is general protection from attackers that have a lot more points. The maximum point difference between a player and the attacker is 1:10. If a weaker player is attacked by a player with more than 1:10 points, a warning will appear. If the attack is carried out, the weaker attacker loses the general 1:10 protection for 7 Days. The start of an attack is a decisive factor in whether the protection works or not and depends on the time of the attack. Running attacks on players on the cusp of the point limit are always carried out, even if the target falls below the point limit during the attack. Attacks will also continue running if the target settlement changes its owner during the attacks. **Highscore attack window** Every player can attack the next 200 players below him in the highscore, regardless of general protection. Alliance members are not included. **New player attack protection phase 1** In the first 5 Days, a player's home town cannot be attacked. This protection expires if the player attacks another player himself. If this is the case, phase 2 automatically starts. **New player attack protection phase 2** For another 7 Days, the player's home town cannot be conquered by other players. Counts can attack this settlement, but will not reduce their realm of power. Conquest protection is also preserved even if a player is in phase 2 and has conquered an abandoned settlement. However, the protection is still only valid for the home town \- the new settlement can be conquered by other players as usual. If a player attacks another player with a Count during phase 2, phase 2 will expire prematurely and conquest protection will be forfeited. **Abandoned settlement** Abandoned settlements will not have any protection whatsoever and can therefore be attacked and conquered by players that have more than 1:10 points. # Introduction
KingsAge is a strategy game that focusses on warfare and on expanding your own empire.
## Build
The player starts by determining the orientation that his first settlement should have. The settlement will then be randomly placed on the map with that orientation. Via the 'castle' menu item, the player (as leader) can decide which buildings to build or extend in this settlement. Some building levels and combinations activate more buildings options.
## Resources
Resources and settlers are needed for this, whereby resources are used up for the building process and settlers are needed to carry out the process. There are three types of resources (stone, wood and ore) that are all automatically produced by the corresponding buildings. The total amount of available settlers will only change when the miller is extended. New settlers are not constantly produced.
## Trade
Resources can be produced as well as traded via the market building. Resources can be offered from the free market or directly swapped amongst players. In order to do this, you need donkeys, which can be bred at the donkey stable .
## Train
After the first extension phase, the player gets access to the barracks . This building enables the player to research the first military units and train them. Units do not have any upkeep costs, but the unit amount is limited by the number of available settlers. If you fulfil particular requirements, more battle unit types can be researched. This means that you can then train more units of this type in the barracks.
## Conquer
If a player survives the development phase, he is in the position to go to war with other players to completely take over their cities (so-called conquering ). In order to do this, the player needs a count , which is a special military unit that has special requirements and is very expensive to produce. To train counts, you need to play for a longer amount of time and extend your city further.
## Attack protection
General protection
 There is general protection from attackers that have a lot more points. The maximum point difference between a player and the attacker is 1:10.
If a weaker player is attacked by a player with more than 1:10 points, a warning will appear. If the attack is carried out, the weaker attacker loses the general 1:10 protection for 7 Days.
The start of an attack is a decisive factor in whether the protection works or not and depends on the time of the attack. Running attacks on players on the cusp of the point limit are always carried out, even if the target falls below the point limit during the attack. Attacks will also continue running if the target settlement changes its owner during the attacks.
Highscore attack window
 Every player can attack the next 200 players below him in the highscore, regardless of general protection. Alliance members are not included.
New player attack protection phase 1
 In the first 5 Days, a player's home town cannot be attacked. This protection expires if the player attacks another player himself. If this is the case, phase 2 automatically starts.
New player attack protection phase 2
 For another 7 Days, the player's home town cannot be conquered by other players. Counts can attack this settlement, but will not reduce their realm of power. Conquest protection is also preserved even if a player is in phase 2 and has conquered an abandoned settlement. However, the protection is still only valid for the home town - the new settlement can be conquered by other players as usual.
If a player attacks another player with a Count during phase 2, phase 2 will expire prematurely and conquest protection will be forfeited.
Abandoned settlement
 Abandoned settlements will not have any protection whatsoever and can therefore be attacked and conquered by players that have more than 1:10 points.

Plan for fetch.ps1:
```powershell
param([string]$ListFile, [int]$From=1, [int]$To=999, [string]$OutDir='research\raw')
$base='https://s59-en.kingsage.gameforge.com/help.php'
$lines = Get-Content $ListFile | Where-Object { $_ -match '\S' -and -not $_.StartsWith('#') }
$session = New-Object Microsoft.PowerShell.Commands.WebRequestSession
Invoke-WebRequest -Uri $base -UseBasicParsing -WebSession $session -TimeoutSec 40 -Headers @{'User-Agent'='Mozilla/5.0'} | Out-Null
$i=0
foreach($line in $lines){
  $i++
  if($i -lt $From -or $i -gt $To){ continue }
  $parts = $line -split '\|'
  $name=$parts[0].Trim(); $q=$parts[1].Trim()
  $url = $base + '?' + $q
  $expectIntro = $name -in @('intro','index')
  $ok=$false
  for($t=1;$t -le 6;$t++){
    try{
      $r = Invoke-WebRequest -Uri $url -UseBasicParsing -WebSession $session -TimeoutSec 40 -Headers @{'User-Agent'='Mozilla/5.0';'Referer'=$base}
      $fb = $r.Content -match 'The player starts by determining'
      if($fb -eq $expectIntro){
        [System.IO.File]::WriteAllText((Join-Path (Get-Location) ($OutDir + '\' + $name + '.html')), $r.Content, [System.Text.Encoding]::UTF8)
        $ok=$true; break
      }
    } catch {}
    Start-Sleep -Seconds 6
  }
  if($ok){ "OK   $name" } else { "FAIL $name" }
  Start-Sleep -Seconds 4
}
```

Note: `.StartsWith` on string works. `-not $_.StartsWith('#')` fine.

########## FILE: intro ##########
class="contentpane" style="min-height: 266px;">
# Introduction
KingsAge is a strategy game that focusses on warfare and on expanding your own empire.
## Build
The player starts by determining the orientation that his first settlement should have. The settlement will then be randomly placed on the map with that orientation. Via the 'castle' menu item, the player (as leader) can decide which buildings to build or extend in this settlement. Some building levels and combinations activate more buildings options.
## Resources
Resources and settlers are needed for this, whereby resources are used up for the building process and settlers are needed to carry out the process. There are three types of resources (stone, wood and ore) that are all automatically produced by the corresponding buildings. The total amount of available settlers will only change when the miller is extended. New settlers are not constantly produced.
## Trade
Resources can be produced as well as traded via the market building. Resources can be offered from the free market or directly swapped amongst players. In order to do this, you need donkeys, which can be bred at the donkey stable .
## Train
After the first extension phase, the player gets access to the barracks . This building enables the player to research the first military units and train them. Units do not have any upkeep costs, but the unit amount is limited by the number of available settlers. If you fulfil particular requirements, more battle unit types can be researched. This means that you can then train more units of this type in the barracks.
## Conquer
If a player survives the development phase, he is in the position to go to war with other players to completely take over their cities (so-called conquering ). In order to do this, the player needs a count , which is a special military unit that has special requirements and is very expensive to produce. To train counts, you need to play for a longer amount of time and extend your city further.
## Attack protection
General protection
 There is general protection from attackers that have a lot more points. The maximum point difference between a player and the attacker is 1:10.
If a weaker player is attacked by a player with more than 1:10 points, a warning will appear. If the attack is carried out, the weaker attacker loses the general 1:10 protection for 7 Days.
The start of an attack is a decisive factor in whether the protection works or not and depends on the time of the attack. Running attacks on players on the cusp of the point limit are always carried out, even if the target falls below the point limit during the attack. Attacks will also continue running if the target settlement changes its owner during the attacks.
Highscore attack window
 Every player can attack the next 200 players below him in the highscore, regardless of general protection. Alliance members are not included.
New player attack protection phase 1
 In the first 5 Days, a player's home town cannot be attacked. This protection expires if the player attacks another player himself. If this is the case, phase 2 automatically starts.
New player attack protection phase 2
 For another 7 Days, the player's home town cannot be conquered by other players. Counts can attack this settlement, but will not reduce their realm of power. Conquest protection is also preserved even if a player is in phase 2 and has conquered an abandoned settlement. However, the protection is still only valid for the home town - the new settlement can be conquered by other players as usual.
If a player attacks another player with a Count during phase 2, phase 2 will expire prematurely and conquest protection will be forfeited.
Abandoned settlement
 Abandoned settlements will not have any protection whatsoever and can therefore be attacked and conquered by players that have more than 1:10 points.

| | Settlements | | Resources | | Favourites | 
# Settlements
In KingsAge, the main game element are settlements. Every settlement has its own unique position on the map, which is identified by the coordinates that it has. Additionally, each settlement has its own name and a ruling player. If the settlement does not have an owner, it will be classed as an abandoned settlement. If a player is unhappy with the name of his settlement, he can rename it. 
A settlement contains the buildings that allow the player to carry out particular actions. Resources are produced, settlers are made available and military units are trained and researched. This allows for settlements to be fought and conquered. With the extension of a settlement, its points and realm of power increase, which makes them more powerful and more difficult to conquer.
## Bonus settlements
Some settlements are so-called bonus settlements. A 'Master', who has special skills and gives the settlement a certain bonus, presides over these settlements. Each settlement can only have one bonus.
- 10% more wood
- 10% more stone
- 10% more ore
- 10% more settlers
- 10% faster troop training
- 3% more raw material production
## Abandoned settlement
Sporadic parts of the world contain abandoned settlements. These settlements once belonged to players whose accounts became inactive. Thus the settlements were forgotten and occupied by robbers.
Abandoned settlements are like normal settlements, except they are controlled by robbers and not by players. Robbers continue to develop the settlements, build buildings and units and increase their maximum number of points.

# Resources
There are three types of resources, as well as settlers in KingsAge. Both are needed for a multitude of possible actions. Resources are consumer goods, which means that they disappear after use. Settlers on the other hand, are bound to certain things (buildings, units...) and are available as long as the object exists.
## Resources
The three different resources are needed for practically all actions. Resources are continually produced by particular buildings and can be traded, sold or bought via the market. Additionally, the player receives a maximum amount of resources that he can store, which depends on the warehouse.
- [] Wood is produced in the [] sawmill
- [] Stone is mined in the [] stone quarry
- [] Iron is mined [] in the ore mine
## Settlers
Settlers are one of the player's resources and limit the player's possessions. Each player settlement has a settlement amount that is available to him in this place for his buildings and units. Each object is bound to these settlers a certain amount and these settlers are then classified as employed. Settlers that are not bound yet are classified as free settlers. If an action requires more settlers than the player has available, the action will not be possible. To extend a settlement nonetheless, the player has to extend the miller, as this determines the exact amount of settlers.
If a settlement loses units or buildings during the course of a game, employed settlers will become available again and can be used for other objects. Units that have left the settlement still effect the number of settlers in their home settlements until they fall in battle.

# Favourites
Players can create favourites in KingsAge. Settlements or players that are needed often are therefore quickly accessible. Additionally favourites can be combined into groups to get a better overview.
In the settlement details the player has the opportunity to add a settlement to his favourites. This means that the coordinates of the settlement are stored for quick access. With every entry possibility for coordinates, the player can then choose a favourite instead of entering coordinates.

class="contentpane" style="min-height: 266px;">
# Buildings
Buildings are necessary if you want to make progress in the game. Amongst other things, they produce other resources and enable different actions, e.g. building units via the barracks or trading at the market.
The following buildings are available:
- [Castle] Castle
 - [Quarry] Quarry
 - [Sawmill] Sawmill
 - [Ore Mine] Ore Mine
 - [Warehouse] Warehouse
 - [Hideout] Hideout
 - [Miller] Miller
 - [Barracks] Barracks
 - [Town Wall] Town Wall
 - [Donkey Stable] Donkey Stable
 - [Market] Market
 - [Alchemist] Alchemist
 - [Residence] Residence
 - [Goldsmith] Goldsmith
 - [Memorial] Memorial
## Build
To build buildings, a player has to go to the castle menu. From there, he can select which buildings should be built from the options available. The resources will then be spent and the building's construction process will start. The building process continues for a predetermined time and after this time has expired, the building will be available. The building process can be cancelled at any time, in which case the invested resources will be reimbursed.
Only one building process per settlement can take part at the same time. However, there is a building queue in which up to three building jobs can be commissioned. These are then gradually completed. If more building jobs are put into the building queue, the costs will increase after the third building. These additional costs will not be reimbursed if the job is cancelled. If the player has an active premium account, the building queue is unlimited.
The additional costs increase exponentially. The cost overview is as follows:
| Buildings | additional costs
| 1 | 0%
| 2 | 0%
| 3 | 0%
| 4 | 25%
| 5 | 56%
| 6 | 95%
| 7 | 144%
| 8 | 205%
| 9 | 281%
| 10 | 376%
## Techtree
The player's different buildings and possibilities are organised in a techtree. This means that the player must fulfil specific requirements to build particular buildings. Thus the player's possible actions increase bit by bit.

# The buildings
 | []
Castle | The castle is the heart of the settlement. It provides its citizens with safety in times of war and is also the place where craftsmen and builders work together to build new buildings and extend existing buildings.
The bigger the castle, the more builders can work there. This also means that the buildings can be built even faster. As soon as the castle has been built up to stage 15, you can tear down buildings, if you have researched the appropriate technique at the alchemist's.
 | []
Quarry | At the stone quarry, boulders are chipped off rocks and processed into stone blocks. These blocks can then be used for building buildings or for troop production in the barracks. The more you expand your quarry, the more stonemasons you can employ and the quicker you can process these rocks into blocks of stone.
 | []
Sawmill | Whether it is needed as a framework for shields or weapons: Wood is the raw material that is needed the most for your settlements. In the sawmill, trees from the surrounding woods are processed and made available to builders and blacksmiths. The further your sawmill is extended, the more workers can be employed to process raw wood.
 | []
Ore Mine | Even the best warriors cannot withstand a battle without good armour and sharp blades. In the ore mine, iron is dug out of the earth and processed. 
If you expand your mine you can employ more workers and they can work faster.
 | []
Warehouse | Resources are safe from wind and weather in the warehouse. Make sure that it always has enough space, otherwise you will lose important resources. Unfortunately your goods will not be safe from pillagers- you need a hideout for that.
 | []
Hideout | Settlers in your settlements cannot always defend their homes. That's why they store their treasures in a secret place hiding place. These hideouts are safe from the hands of thieves and the eyes of spies.
 | []
Miller | The fruits of the field are ground in the mill. Flour allows the miller to provide for your settlements, so that none of your kingdom's citizens have to starve. All your workers and troops want to be fed though. So you can only employ as many as you can provide for.
 | []
Barracks | In the barracks tough rules and an even harsher treatment reigns in order to teach discipline and tactics. Warriors are trained here to loyally serve their King. You can also send them into battle, where they will stand by your side in all their bravery and glory.
The more you extend your barracks, the more advanced your units will be.
 | []
Town Wall | A strong town wall keeps your villagers safe from hungry wolves and attacking enemies. When a settlement is being defended, the wall increases (depending on its level) the combat strength of your local troops.
 | []
Donkey Stable | At the donkey stable, loyal pack animals are raised, who will patiently carry heavy loads for you. The larger the stable, the more donkeys can be bred there.
 | []
Market | The market is a hustle and bustle of colourful activity. Merchants from near and far come here to do business. Resources are bought here or sent on long trips. Carrier donkeys are available for the transport, that you can breed at the donkey breeding stable. The more your market is extended, the more you can trade and the larger the space is for market stalls and donkeys, who can be loaded up with goods.
 | []
Alchemist | In the Alchemist's kitchen wondrous things are produced. During your search for the Stone of the Wise, you will also find, next to foul smelling concoctions, many a useful thing. The larger your laboratory is, the more successful the research will be.
 | []
Residence | Counts are loyal people who take charge of your kingdom's daily dealings in your name. If they take on their post in a new settlement, they need golden armour to symbolise their power. You can produce golden armour at the Goldsmith's.
 | []

# Units
The units in KingsAge are military troops that the player can research and train. Both actions cost resources and settlers. If the player has units, he can defend himself, other players or attack and pillage deserted settlements. Special units also have additional skills like the spies' espionage or the count who can even permanently take over foreign settlements (so-called conquering).
## Research
Before a player can hire units, he has to research the corresponding unit type. In order to do this, he has to fulfil the unit type requirements and spend a certain amount of resources in the barracks. The research itself lasts a particular amount of time, which is reduced with the increasing barrack level. 
The count is an exception, as counts do not have to be researched in the barracks.

| | Units | | Commands | | Support | | Espionage | | Conquer | | Battles | 
# Commands
A player's units can be sent to attack via the barracks. An attack is not necessarily a direct military attack, but rather a command to own units. Thereby alliance members or own settlements cannot be attacked.
There are the following possibilities for an attack:
- An attack can attack an opposing settlement. Once a troop reaches its destination, the battle commences. 
 - If the battle is successful, own resources can be pillaged.
- Counts can conquer and permanently occupy a settlement.
- Spies can use espionage to find out more about opposing settlements.
- Units can support own or friendly settlements to defend them against attacks.
## Attack protection
Players can put their settlements under attack protection. Thus they cannot be attacked. The following protection options are available:
- 5 Days complete protection: In the first 5 Days after founding the first settlement, the player cannot be attacked (protection is lost when you attack an opponent)
- Outlawed: All your settlements are under a permanent protection from attack. No player that has more than 10 times your points can attack you.
Many weak players can unite their armies and then pose a challenge to stronger players. But take caution: if you carry out the attack, you will be outlawed and lose your 10 to 1 protection against stronger players for 2 Months! 
- Players in sleep mode cannot be attacked
## Attack Warning
To get an overview of incoming attacks, there are two flags on the interface page. If both flags are opened, the player is directly attacked. If just the right one is opened, alliance members will be attacked. If the player clicks on an open flag, he will reach an overview of the corresponding attacks.
## Pillage
If the attacker wins a battle, then his units will pillage the enemy settlement. Then the capacity of the surviving units will be added up. The units can then drag this total number of resources back to their home settlement. This number is then also divided into three different types: wood, stone and iron. The resource amount of the settlement is never smaller than the capacity of the hideout. 
As soon as own troops arrive in your home town, the player will be credited with the pillaged resources.

# Support
Own units can be sent to friendly settlements to support them. The units will then move to the settlement. Once they have arrived there, they will be stationed there until further notice and will help defend the settlement. During battle, they will be treated as normal units on location and will profit from the local town wall and memorial bonuses. 
During support, the troops will occupy the normal amount of settlers in their home town. If troops die, the corresponding settlers will be freed as normal.
If a player wants to use supporting troops elsewhere, he has to command them back and send them to a new destination from there. There is no limit to the amount of troops that can support a settlement.

class="contentpane" style="min-height: 266px;">
| | Units | | Commands | | Support | | Espionage | | Conquer | | Battles | 
# Espionage
Espionage uses spies to spy on other player's settlements. This allows you to gain information about buildings, resources and the units of the settlement, which can simplify attack planning. Whereby the player has the choice between a normal espionage attack and the slower but invisible creeping espionage.
## Start espionage
When starting an attack, a player can choose between two types (normal and creeping). Normal espionage can be started via the normal attack command. Creeping espionage can be started via a special espionage button. 
If a player decides on using a normal espionage attack, then the opponent is immediately visible. Additionally the attacked player receives reports, like during a normal attack.
If a player selects the creeping espionage attack, the attack is invisible to the opponent. This means that he will not get any information when the spies arrive and he will never receive a report. As the spy will be especially careful, his movement speed will be clearly slowed down on the map.
## Calculation
During an espionage attack the ratio of attack spies and defending spies is calculated. From that the value the amount of surviving troops is calculated. The defender will never lose units. At the end, all spies return to their home town. The espionage type and the amount of surviving, attacking spies determines the information that the settler receives.
## Conquer
After the battle the information that the attacking player receives is checked. Thereby the following espionage types are relevant again:
During a normal espionage attack, spies can receive the following information:
 enemy troops & morale
 enemy resources
 buildings and their expansion levels
 troops outside the settlement
During a creeping espionage attack the following information is available:
 enemy troops & morale
 enemy resources
 buildings and their expansion levels

| | Units | | Commands | | Support | | Espionage | | Conquer | | Battles | 
# Conquer
During conquests, opposing settlements are permanently occupied by counts. For this to happen, the city's realm of power, an abstract representation of the player's influence on this settlement, must drop to 0. 
A foreign, attacking count, that survives the battle against the defenders can reduce this realm of influence. In the process, a random value between 2,250 and 2,750 is subtracted from the realm of power. However, if the attacked settlement has a memorial, the realm of influence is only reduced by 1,750 to 2,250. Independent of the actual number, the count can only reduce his realm of power up to a maximum of half of the maximum. Only one count can be effective per attack.
For each settlement, at least two counts are required in two separated attacks. However, a fully extended settlement (10,000 realm of power) including a memorial needs at least five or six counts (or rather attacks).
As soon as the realm of power has been reduced to 0 points, the settlement becomes the property of the player that sent the count that caused the last realm of power damage. After a conquest, the new leader's realm of power immediately increases to 30% of the maximum.

########## FILE: units_battle ##########
class="contentpane" style="min-height: 266px;">
| | Units | | Commands | | Support | | Espionage | | Conquer | | Battles | 
# Battles
If a player attacks another player's settlement, a battle will start. The individual units will fight against each other until one side is completely destroyed. This can also cause permanent damage to the settlement (town wall or other buildings). The winner can then either pillage the settlement's resources or conquer them (permanently take them over) using counts.
The levels of a battle are:
- Damaging the town wall
- Battle of the spies
- Normal troops battle
- Damaging buildings
- Conquests and Pillaging
## Damaging the town wall
Before the actual battle commences, the value of the town wall is reduced. To do this, the player needs battering ram units in his attack troop. The level of the town wall is reduced depending on the amount of rams carried.
## Battle of the spies
If spies are in the rows of the attacking army, then espionage is calculated normally before the battle starts.
## Normal troops battle
The normal units fight against each other. The attack values are compared to the defence values. Once the values are determined, they may also be modified by outside circumstances.
The following modifiers are valid for the attacker:
- Morale: Is a mechanism that is supposed to stop overpowering players from destroying smaller players. The attacking player's total points from all settlements are compared to the defender's total amount of points. If the attacker has more, then the effectiveness of his units is reduced, as the morale is reduced. Morale moves between 100% and 30%. 
- Luck: A random factor, that is randomly decided at every battle. This value influences battle strength. Luck varies between -25% and +25%.
The defender can improve the defence values of his units with:
- Wall bonus: This bonus is generated by the town wall and improves all defence values. The wall bonus goes from 100% (Level 0) to 220% (Level 20).
- Night bonus: This is protection that supports attacks between 00:00 and 08:00. During this time, the defender profits from a night bonus, which means: double the defence strength of all units during this time. Outside of this time there is no other defence bonus.
Once the battle values are compared, the losses are determined. The count dies if no more troops have been sent out and a battle has occurred, or when 50% of the attacker's units have died.
## Damaging buildings
At the end, the destruction of other buildings is exactly calculated and is dependent on the defender's losses and the attacker's number of trebuchets.
## Conquests and Pillaging
Once the battle is over and the attacker has won, the following will happen: The attacker's surviving troops will pillage the resource supply of the settlement and take the goods to their home town. If some of the counts have survived, they will start conquering the settlement and destroying its realm of power.
The realm of power will be recalculated after the conquest attempt. If a building is destroyed by the attack, then it will have an effect on the realm of power.

########## FILE: map ##########
class="contentpane" style="min-height: 266px;">
# Map
There is a map on the KingsAge interface. If a player accesses the map, part of the world will be displayed. Thus a player can get an overview of the premises surrounding his settlements. 
Different settlement graphics display the approximate progress of the corresponding settlement. Settlements in vacation mode are displayed in grey. Bonus settlements are displayed with a golden glow. 
Additionally, settlements are colourfully highlighted. The caption for it is at the lower edge of the map. As members of an alliance, allies are emphasized. Players with premium accounts can also highlight the map themselves.
## Minimap
In addition to the map, the player also has access to the minimap. This displays a bigger section of the world and displays a clear overview. Colours are used to display the different settlements. 
There are different settings in regard to the minimap. Two options are accessible for each player, more are unlocked with a premium account.
## World
The world of KingsAge includes the whole game field. Its construction is the same on every server, however its contents varies. The world is persistent, which means that the users' actions and their effects will still exist even if the player does not play anymore. 
Every world consists of 1,000x1,000 tiles that are divided into 'continents'. An area of 100x100 tiles equals one continent. Thus the whole world consists of 10x10 continents.
## Alchemist
At the alchemist's you can research techniques. It will cost the player some resources, but will also give him a permanent bonus. Most techniques have an effect on the map's display. Once the technique has been researched once, it becomes global, activated in all player's settlements and does not even have to be researched again. Some techniques have to be additionally activated in the map settings.

class="contentpane" style="min-height: 266px;">
| | Player | | Points | | Ranking | | Friends | | Trade | | Messages | 
# Player
In KingsAge the player takes over the role of leading several settlements. He can erect buildings and train units to protect his own resources and settlements. He can also use his military to pillage or take over foreign settlements or to expand his kingdom. If the player does not have any settlements left, he has to start from the beginning to continue playing.
## Share internet connection
To prevent multi-accounts, IP sharing is banned. However, because it cannot always be avoided (same internet connection e.g. internet caf�s) , there is the option in the player profile to Share internet connection.
To avoid any misunderstandings, you have to specify whether a connection is being shared. You should enter all the players who you know you are sharing a connection with.
You cannot send players that you are registered with resources or support. This entry is valid for at least 3 days and once that time has passed, it can be removed again.
## Inactivity
If a player does not play for longer period of time, he is classed as inactive. Inactive users will be deleted from the system after a particular amount of time. The following rules apply:
Normal accounts (no premium account) are deleted after 35 days of inactivity. Warning e-mails will be sent out to the player after 7, 15 and 30 days. In these e-mails the inhabitants will beg their leader to return. If the player does not log in after 35 days, the account will be deleted.
Accounts with a premium account (PA) will not be deleted as long as the PA is active. Once the PA runs out, the account will be treated as a normal account after the expiry date (see above).
Normal accounts in sleep mode (without PA) will not be deleted, however, vacation mode expires after 60 consecutive vacation days and after that the player will be subjected to the normal deletion period.
## Sleep mode
If a player is away for a longer period of time and cannot play KingsAge, his settlements will be in danger of being conquered. To prevent this, the player can activate sleep mode (SM) for a predetermined time.
SM is like a 'pause button'. While SM is activated, the player does not have an effect on the world's events and vice versa. In SM, the player cannot carry out any actions and no other player can interact with the sleeping player. Actions started prior to the SM will continue. Actions that take a longer amount of time and involve other player are paused or suspended where possible. 
Additionally SM will be publicly displayed next to the user name - in the alliance list as well as the player profile details. Settlements in SM are also displayed in grey on the map.
## Holiday replacement
Like sleep mode holiday replacement (HR) exists to prevent players that are absent from the game for a longer amount of time from being punished for being away. However, HR is a premium feature, for which the player requires an activated premium account.
HR gives another player the right to manage your own account. He can then log in to your account without your password and play the game for you.
You can also set the precise rights that your replacement should have. Particular actions (such as writing and reading messages) can therefore be prevented. 
Players that are representing others cannot attack each other. This protection is also valid for another 7 days after the HR has expired.

########## FILE: player_points ##########
class="contentpane" style="min-height: 266px;">
| | Player | | Points | | Ranking | | Friends | | Trade | | Messages | 
# Points
Each settlement has a particular amount of points which symbolise the settlement's progress in an abstract way. The amount of points also determines the maximum realm of power. A settlement's realm of power is an abstract representation of the player's influence on this settlement.
## Settlement points
Every building has a certain number of points per extension level that are added to the points of the settlement. Thus the approximate strength of a settlement is displayed. Points will automatically be added to your account as soon as the building's construction has finished, however it will not be immediately displayed in the statistics so that enemies cannot find out any information about you. Troops, battles and research will not influence your score. 
A player's total points are also used to level out the battles between unequal opponents. There is also a morale mechanism during battle.
## Total points
The player's total amount of points determines his ranking in the highscore. They are also significant for the general attack protection. 
The total points are calculated by the sum of settlement points and bonus points for the number of settlements, or to be exact:
Total points = all settlement points + 2500 points per settlement (the first is not included in the calculation)
## Building points
Every building has a certain number of points per extension level that are added to the points of the settlement. Thus the approximate strength of a settlement is displayed. Points will automatically be added to your account as soon as the building's construction has finished, however it will not be immediately displayed in the statistics so that enemies cannot find out any information about you. Troops, battles and research will not influence your score. 
A player's total points are also used to level out the battles between unequal opponents. There is also a morale mechanism during battle.
## Realm of Power
The realm of power fluctuates between 0 and the total amount of points of a settlement. Because the maximum points of a settlement can never exceed 10,000, the realm of power is also limited to 10,000. If the value is below the maximum, then it increases by 1% of the maximum value per hour. 
The realm of power can be reduced by the influence of the count. If the realm of power is reduced to 0 by it, the settlement is conquered and becomes the attacker's possession.

# Ranking
There are several rankings with which players and alliances can compare themselves with one another. Every server has its own ranking.
The available rankings are:
- Players: Players are measured according to the current total points of all their settlements
- Alliances: Arranges alliances according to their current total points
- defeated opponents: Grades the individual players via their total number of destroyed units and can be filtered 'As attacker', 'As defender' or 'Total'
- defeated opponents in the alliance: Grades the different alliances via their total number of destroyed units and can be filtered 'As attacker', 'As defender' or 'Total'
- Battles: Grades the individual players via their total number of won battles (even if you have started anew)
- Alliance battles: Grades the different alliances via their total number of won battles (even if you have started anew)
- Pillory: Displays players whose accounts have been temporarily or permanently banned

# Friends
To help remember important players, they can be added as favourites. Thus you can quickly get access to their profile via the favourites menu and can write to them more easily in the message menu. 
A player can also add other players as friends. In order to this the player has to be added as a favourite and then be sent a request via the 'Friend' button. This has to be confirmed by the opponent. Once it has been confirmed, the system will mark both players as friends.
The advantage of friends is:
- You can communicate via the interface more quickly with friends (via messages)
- A friend's online status can be made visible. There are three levels:
- 
- active
- has been inactive for 2 days
- has been inactive for a week

# Messages
In KingsAge, players can send each other messages. Additionally messages from the game itself can be used to inform the players about particular incidences in the world. These automatic messages are called reports.
The storage time of messages is limited, regardless of their content. You can find information about the different durations below. This duration is clearly extended for users with a premium account. Additionally, players have the opportunity to sort their messages into files.
# Reports
There are the following message types:
Battle report: this report is sent to a player after a battle.
Spy report: this report appears after the completion of espionage.
# Safe-keeping
Messages will only be kept for a certain amount of time. Once this time runs up, they are deleted in order to keep the database size down. The length of time that they are kept for can vary from server to server. Remaining:
- Normal server 
 - In premium inboxes: 90 Days
- Read: 5 Days
- Unread: 7 Days
- Speed server 
 - In premium inboxes: 90 Days
- Read: 3 Days
- Unread: 3 Days

# Trade
Via trade, players can swap resources with one another. A player needs the market building to be able to trade. The donkey stable is not necessary, but it is very important for players that trade a lot.
## Donkeys
To trade, a player needs donkeys. Every donkey has a particular amount of resources that he can transport. After arriving at the destination settlement, the donkey does not return, meaning that it has to be re-bred. As soon as the donkey leaves its settlement, it will be reproduced. There is a basic production for this (donkey per hour), that is increased by the level of the donkey stable, while the market determines the maximum holding capacity of the donkey.

class="contentpane" style="min-height: 266px;">
# Alliances
An alliance is the union of different players to a collective organisation. 
Thereby each player has control over his own membership, but an alliance also has control over its members. This means that:
If a player wants to become a member of an alliance, he has to be sent an invitation from a current member first. If the player accepts this invitation, he'll become a member of the alliance. However, the invitation can also be withdrawn by the alliance before the player accepts it. 
If the player is already a member of an alliance, he can swap alliances by accepting the invitation from a foreign alliance. Alternatively he can also leave his current alliance at any time. Or the alliance can throw him out without asking.
## Benefits
As a member of an alliance, you have the following advantages:
- Alliance forums for improved communication
- Overview of attacks from or on alliance members on the alliance pages and the flag attack warnings
- Member list (with an overview of points, rank, rank position, number of settlements and activity status)
- Marking of all alliance settlements on the map (green)
- As soon as you belong to an alliance, you can define the 'Alliance member titles' yourself. This title will be listed next to your player name (in highscores...).
- Other non-mechanical advantages like:
- 
- mutual protection and support during battle
- Organisation, to achieve even bigger goals
- get to know new players in the game
## Alliance forum
In KingsAge, every alliance gets its own alliance forum that the alliance can manage itself. This forum is completely controlled by the alliance and can only be seen by alliance members. This allows the members to get to know one another and communicate with one another.
## Manage alliance
The alliance can be managed by different members. The possible actions each member can take depend on the rights of their respective rank. You can find details about the rights in the section on 'Managing members'.
### Found an alliance
If a player wants to found a new alliance, he cannot already belong to an alliance. To found an alliance, the player simply has to click on the 'Alliance' link and enter a name and an alliance tag. Both must have individual descriptions and the tag cannot contain more than 6 characters. Once you have done this, the new alliance is founded and has one member: The founder, who will have the 'council of elders' title.
### Change data
Once the alliance has been founded, the members, depending on their rights, can enter different data or change data. The following settings are available:
- Description: This somewhat longer text serves as a public information board for all players. The text can be modified with BB-Codes and can be viewed by every player, even non-members. To change it, the player must have diplomacy rights.
- Name: The alliance name can also be changed afterwards, but has the same restrictions as a newly founded alliance.
- Tag: Can also be changed at will.
- An emblem can also be added to the alliance. The emblem is a simple graphic that is displayed on the alliance profile. It can have a maximum size of 256 kByte and the picture must have a JPG, GIF or PNG format.
- The homepage of the alliance can be entered if you wish. It is also openly accessible information.
- If an alliance has an IRC-channel, it can also be entered. However, this info is only for alliance members.
- You can enter a link to the external forum of the alliance with the external forum link. This link replaces the normal link to the KingsAge forum. This info is also just for alliance members.
- Similar to the overview text, the internal messages are a large, formatable text field. However, the messages are only displayed to members of the alliance. Only the alliance leader can change this text.
### Manage members
A large part of managing the alliance is administering own members, for which the following means are available:
- The alliance can throw existing members out of the alliance.
- Individual members can be assigned to ranks directly. (At least one of the members must be in the council of elders) If a point ranking is assigned directly (see below), then it will be activated independently of the normally required point score for this player. To cancel a rank assignment, a player is not given a rank. This means that the system will automatically assign the right point rank.
- Players that are not members of the alliance yet can be invited.
- Pending invitations can be withdrawn.
### Administrate ranks
Aside from administering members, the managing and modification of the individual alliance ranks also plays a big part. The ranks are automatically created when an alliance is founded, but they can also be changed. Every rank has its own determinable characteristics:
- Rank type: These are divided into point ranking or special ranking. The point ranking depends on the player's amount of points. Special ranking is directly distributed.
- Points: Only play a part in point rankings and display the minimum amount of points that you need to distribute the rank.
- Name: The name of the rank.
- A rank's rights are split into different individual yes/no questions, which determine what the player is allowed to do within an alliance:
- Alliance forum: Allows the player to access the forum and read and write in it
- Circular mail: Allows the player to send messages to all members of the alliance
- hidden forums: Allows access to the hidden parts of the forum
- Moderator: Gives the user moderator rights for the internal forum in the alliance forum
- Diplomacy: The player can start and end confederations and edit internal announcements
- Invitations: Gives a member the right to invite other people into the alliance and withdraw the invitations
- Alliance leader
- Board of elders
The following administration options are available:
- Removing ranks: Deletes an existing rank. However, the last rank with the 'Board of elders' right cannot be deleted. Special rankings can only be deleted when they are not distributed any more.
- Adding ranks: Creates a new rank. This can be optionally defined.
- Changing ranks: Can completely change a rank. Any changes made will become effective immediately for all members that have this rank. If a point ranking becomes a special ranking, all members that had the point ranking due to their number of points will also receive the new special ranking.
### Diplomacy
Aside from getting members, an alliance must endeavour to form diplomatic relations with other alliances. Thus so-called confederations can be formed. The confederation status of settlements (that have members of an allied alliance) is highlighted on the map. The following confederations are available:
- Allies (yellow): If an alliance member wants to attack the settlement of an allied alliance, it has to be explicitly confirmed first.
- Non-aggression pact (NAP) (Orange): If an alliance member wants to attack the settlement of a non-aggression-pact alliance, then it must be explicitly confirmed.
- Enemies (Red): Enemies do not have a technical impact on the game.
There are the following options for managing them:
- New alliances can be created. In order to do this, you must enter the tag of the target alliance and the type of confederation. The target alliance does not have to confirm it and will not have confederate from their side. The target alliance will not automatically be informed about the alliance.
- Existing alliances can simply be terminated.
### Manage forum
Alliance members with particular rights can directly manage the alliance from the forum. In addition, the sub forums (files) of the forum can be changed:
- The name of a sub forum can be changed.
- Sub forums are usually displayed with the corresponding ('Alliance forum') right, but can also be hidden. Some sub forums can only be accessed by particular members ('Hidden Forums').
- The order of the sub forums can be changed any way you like. In order to do this, a sub forum is moved up or down.
- A sub forum can be completely deleted. This means that all the threads in this file will also be deleted.
- New sub forum can be opened. Its status can be directly specified as hidden.
### Administrate forum
Alliance members with the moderator right can moderate alliance forums. They have the following options:
- Deleting threads
- Moving threads to another forum
- Closing and opening threads. All closed threads cannot (apart from moderators) have any new threads added.

class="contentpane" style="min-height: 266px;">
# Game rules
The T&Cs are being amended with the following game rules. In the event of inconsistency between the game rules and the T&Cs, the T&Cs apply.
The following points apply to all game worlds. If you think you have been blocked or banned unfairly, please contact the responsible Game Operator via the ticket system.
Please note that complaints and requests to do with the particulars of an account's data privacy can only be dealt with via the owner of the account.
## Accounts
Every player can register for KingsAge several times, but can only own one game account per world. 
### Access to the account, account sitting & account sharing
Only the owner has access to the account. So-called "sitting" or "account sharing", in which the account is played by the registered player as well as other people, is not allowed.
The only way you can let your account be sitted is by the "holiday replacement" premium feature. Non-premium players can use sleep mode as an alternative for the replacement function. 
Passing on passwords is not permitted. 
### Account transfer
If an account is passed onto another player, support has to be informed about it and support's approval has to be obtained. There is no legal claim to an account transference. A transfer can only occur completely, individual worlds cannot be transferred. Please note that 'Crowns' are bound to an account. Thus they stay on the transferred account and can only be used by the new owner of the account. 
## Sharing internet connections
The game has a 'Share internet connection' function that is displayed in the profile under the same description. This function must be used by every person who knowingly uses the same network or the same computer as another player in the same world. Examples of shared networks are school networks, universities or work places. 
To prevent a ban, support should be informed before you play on a foreign network.
Any violations against the 'Share internet connection' function can result in temporary or permanent bans. 
## Pushing
It is not permitted to use a weaker account for your own advantage (e.g. in form of a resource yield) 
## Bugusing
A bug is an in-game error which could create unfair advantages for certain players. You cannot take advantage of these bugs. Should you become the victim of a bug, it is imperative that you notify a Game Operator. 
## Bots and scripts
Please take note of the terms and conditions, item 5: 'Special terms and conditions for the use of online games' and all subsections from 5.1 to 5.7.
There are certain tools that are allowed. A list of permissible scripts can be found in the forum.
Should you be unsure whether a tool that you have is permissible or not, please contact support and send them the script.
If you have written your own script, please contact game support and ask if it is allowed before publishing it. 
## Contents
Insults, abuse, and all offensive messages are forbidden and anyone sending such messages will be punished. 
Threats are only permissible if they relate exclusively to the game and have absolutely no connection to any other platform or to the private life of any players. Political, racial, pornographic or other illegal expression is not allowed on any KingsAge-related platform.
Gameforge reserves the right to block any player who does not understand or cannot express himself in the language of the domain on which he plays.
This applies as much to the game as it does to the official forum and the IRC channel.
These rules also apply to:
In-game messages, alliance pages and circular mail.
Please bear in mind that any misbehaviour in the game, in the forum, or on IRC can result in the temporary or permanent blocking of your account.
It is absolutely forbidden to spread immoral content in order to insult the integrity of a player or person. In-game moral boundaries are preserved and defended by the game team. Certain content may be censored, and the corresponding accounts temporarily or permanently blocked.
This rule also applies to In-game messages, profiles, nicknames, settlement names, alliance pages and circular mails. 
[]
 Details 
 You are allowed to extort resources from other players. 
 You are not allowed to blackmail players for 'Crowns' or other items that do not have anything to do with KingsAge's free offers.
 Insults or other objectionable messages are prohibited.
 Every attempt at accessing other players' passwords (phishing) is strictly prohibited and will be punished.
 You are not allowed to divulge political, racist or pornographic ideas in the game. This includes, for example, the player profile, alliance profile, nicknames and settlement names.
 Links that lead to 'warez' or pornographic pages are prohibited.
 Every player that insults others in the forum or in the IRC chat runs the risk of being banned in the game.
## Spam
Any attempt to impede a player's view which prevents said player from normal play is not permitted.
This is also valid for:
 Spam via messages (IGM)
 Distribution of other games.

# Premium
## Throne room
Special items can be purchased and Crowns can be swapped in the throne room.
## Relics
Relics are helpful and versatile items that you can buy for Crowns. They are distributed in different categories.
The bronze, silver or golden borders around a relic gives them their approximate value and power. Aside from the relic costs, the amount that a player already has in his inventory is displayed in the relic list. 
One click on the relic opens a scroll with detailed information and an exact description. If the relic has a particular runtime or a cooldown time, it will be displayed here.
Most relics can be immediately activated here by clicking on the activate button. Some relics are activated according to the context. Building plans that reduce the building time of a building that is being built are, for example, directly activated in the castle's building menu.
The premium account is also available in the form of a relic. You can find the royal advisers in the miscellaneous category. 
The activated relics' remaining runtime is displayed at the top of the screen in the form of a buff icon. The tooltip of the buff icon displays the exact remaining runtime.
## Crowns
To profit from KingsAge's premium features, the player must purchase the premium currency, Crowns, first. 
These can be bought for real money. If the player has Crowns, he can invest them in relics.
## Premium-account
The premium account is purchased for a particular period of time and gives the player access to several different features during that time:
## Benefits
- Building queue
- 
Put as many building jobs into the building queue as you like, without having to pay additional costs.
Details
Allows you to put lots of building jobs in the building queue without having to pay additional costs. These are then completed consecutively.

```powershell
function Parse-BuildingPage($html){
  $r = @{}
  $m = [regex]::Match($html,'<h1[^>]*>(.*?)</h1>','Singleline')
  $r.name = ($m.Groups[1].Value -replace '<[^>]+>','').Trim()
  # description: text between </h1> and 'Maximum level'
  $start = $html.IndexOf('</h1>')
  $endM = [regex]::Match($html,'Maximum level')
  $descHtml = $html.Substring($start, $endM.Index - $start)
  $r.description = Clean-Text $descHtml
  $r.maxLevel = [int]([regex]::Match($html,'Maximum level:\s*<b>(\d+)</b>').Groups[1].Value)
  ...
}
```

A magnificent statue stands in the middle of the settlement square to remind the villagers and the passing folk of your royal greatness. At the donkey stable, loyal pack animals are raised, who will patiently carry heavy loads for you. The larger the stable, the more donkeys can be bred there.

**Gereksinimler:** Market (Lv 1)

# Miller  `(farm)`  

The fruits of the field are ground in the mill. Flour allows the miller to provide for your settlements, so that none of your kingdom's citizens have to starve. All your workers and troops want to be fed though. So you can only employ as many as you can provide for.

**Maksimum seviye:** 50  
**Gereksinimler:** yok

**Tool: write**

**Input:**
```json
{
  "content": "Add-Type -AssemblyName System.Web\n$c = [System.IO.File]::ReadAllText('research\\raw\\player_points.html')\n$m = [regex]::Match($c, '(?s)<table[^>]*borderlist[^>]*>(.*?)</table>')\n$trs = [regex]::Matches($m.Groups[1].Value, '(?s)<tr>(.*?)</tr>')\n\n$head = $trs[0].Groups[1].Value\n$keys = @()\nforeach ($x in [regex]::Matches($head, 'src=\"/img/buildings/([a-z]+)\\.png\"')) { $keys += $x.Groups[1].Value }\n\n$levels = @()\nfor ($i = 1; $i -lt $trs.Count; $i++) {\n  $tds = [regex]::Matches($trs[$i].Groups[1].Value, '(?s)<td[^>]*>(.*?)</td>')\n  if ($tds.Count -lt 2) { continue }\n  $lv = [int](($tds[0].Groups[1].Value -replace '<[^>]+>', '') -replace '[^0-9]', '')\n  $obj = [ordered]@{ level = $lv }\n  for ($k = 0; $k -lt $keys.Count; $k++) {\n    $idx = $k + 1\n    $val = 0\n    if ($idx -lt $tds.Count) {\n      $t = ($tds[$idx].Groups[1].Value -replace '<[^>]+>', '') -replace '[^0-9]', ''\n      if ($t -ne '') { $val = [int]$t }\n    }\n    $obj[$keys[$k]] = $val\n  }\n  $levels += [pscustomobject]$obj\n}\n\nNew-Item -ItemType Directory -Force -Path 'data' | Out-Null\n@{ keys = $keys; levels = $levels } | ConvertTo-Json -Depth 6 | Set-Content 'data\\building-points.json' -Encoding UTF8\n\n# Markdown\n$nameMap = @{ main='Castle'; stone='Quarry'; wood='Sawmill'; iron='Ore Mine'; storage='Warehouse'; hide='Hideout';\n  farm='Miller'; barracks='Barracks'; wall='Town Wall'; stable='Donkey Stable'; market='Market';\n  garage='Alchemist'; snob='Residence'; smith='Goldsmith'; statue='Memorial' }\n\n$md = \"# Bina Puanlari (seviye basina toplam puan)`n`n\"\n$md += \"Kapali saray: her bina seviyesinin verdigi puan. Bir yerlesimin puanı = binalarin puanlari toplami.`n`n\"\n$md += \"| Lv | \" + (($keys | ForEach-Object { $nameMap[$_] }) -join ' | ') + \" | **Toplam** |`n\"\n$md += \"|\" + ('---:|' * ($keys.Count + 2)) + \"`n\"\nforeach ($row in $levels) {\n  $sum = 0\n  $cells = @()\n  foreach ($k in $keys) { $cells += $row.$k; $sum += $row.$k }\n  $md += \"| $($row.level) | \" + ($cells -join ' | ') + \" | **$sum** |`n\"\n}\nSet-Content 'docs\\reference\\puan-tablosu.md' $md -Encoding UTF8\n\n$maxRow = $levels | Where-Object { $_.level -eq 50 }\n$maxSum = 0; foreach ($k in $keys) { $maxSum += $maxRow.$k }\nWrite-Output (\"seviye satiri: \" + $levels.Count + \"  tam gelismis yerlesim puanı: \" + $maxSum)\n",
  "path": "C:\\Users\\Gorkem\\Desktop\\kingsage\\research\\make-points.ps1"
}
```

########## TR: intro ##########
class="contentpane" style="min-height: 266px;">
# Tanıtım
KingsAge savaş konusuna odaklanmış ve kendi imparatorluğunu kurmaya yönelik bir strateji oyunudur.
## İnşa et
Oyuncu oryantasyona ilk yerleşiminin olması gereken yeri belirleyerek başlıyor.Daha sonra yerleşim, oryantasyonla birlikte haritada rastgele yerleştiriliyor."Kale" menü itemi ile, oyuncu (lider olarak) bu yerleşimde hangi binayı kuracağına veya geliştireceğine karar verebiliyor.
Bazı bina seviyeleri ve kombinasyonları daha fazla bina seçeneğini aktif ediyor.
## Hammaddeler
Bunun için hammaddeler ve vatandaşlar gereklidir. Hammaddeler bina yapımı için kullanılır ve sürecin yürütülmesi için de vatandaşlar gerekir. Binaların otomatik olarak ürettiği üç tip hammadde vardır (taş, odun ve demir). Kullanılabilir vatandaşların toplam sayısı ancak değirmen geliştiğinde degişir. Sürekli yeni vatandaş üretilmez.
## Ticaret
Üretim dışında ham maddelerin Market binası üzerinden ticareti de mümkündür. Hammaddeler açık pazara sunulabilir ya da doğrudan oyuncular arasında takas edilebilir. Bunu yapabilmek için, katır çiftliğinde yetiştirilebilen katırlara ihtiyaç vardır.
## Eğit
Birinci genişleme safhasından sonra, oyuncu kışlaya giriş hakkını kazanır. Bu bina oyuncunun askeri birimleri araştırmasını ve akabinde eğitmesini sağlar. Birimlerin herhangi bir bakım masrafı yoktur, fakat birim sayısı sadece kullanılabilir vatandaş sayısı ile sınırlıdır. Eğer gerekli eksiklikler tamamlanırsa, daha fazla savaş birimi araştırılabilir ve bu tip birimler kışlada eğitilebilir.
## Fethetmek
Bir oyuncu gelişme evresini tamamlarsa, diğer oyunculara karşı savaşabilir ve onların şehirlerini tamamen ele geçirebilir duruma gelir. Buna fethetmek de denilebilir. Bunu yapabilmek için oyuncuya, kont , üretimi pahalı ve mükemmel koşulları olan özel bir askeri birim lâzımdır. Kont eğitebilmesi için, uzun süre oyun oynayıp şehirlerini epeyce geliştirmesi gerekir.
## Saldırı koruması
Genel Koruma
 Genel koruma, çok daha fazla puanı olan saldıranlardan korur. Oyuncu ve saldıranın arasındaki maksimum puan farkı 1:10 oranındadır.
Zayıf bir oyuncu 1:10 üzeri bir oyuncuya saldırdığı durumda ikaz edilir. Saldırı gerçekleşirse, zayıf oyuncu 7 Gün boyunca 1:10 korumasından mahrum kalır.
Korumanın ne zaman geçerli olup olmayacağı, saldırının ne zaman başladığına bağlıdır. Puan farkı sınırında olan oyunculara, arada puan farkı sınırın altına düşülmesi durumunda dahi düzenli olarak saldırılır. Aynı şekilde, saldırı esnasında hedef köyün sahibi değişse bile saldırılar devam eder.
Yüksek Skor Saldırı Penceresi
 Her oyuncu, genel korumaya bakmaksızın, Yüksek Skor'da altındaki ilk 200 oyuncuya saldırabilir. İttifak üyeleri hariç.
Yeni oyuncular için saldırı koruması, 1. Etap
 İlk 5 Gün içerisinde oyuncunun köyüne saldırı düzenlenemez. Oyuncu bizzat başka bir oyuncuya saldırırsa, bu koruma sona erer. Bu durumda otomatik olarak 2. etap başlar.
Yeni oyuncular için saldırı koruması, 2. Etap
 Oyuncun ait olduğu köy 7 Gün gün daha ele geçirilmez, yani diğer oyuncular tarafından fethedilemez. Kontlar bu köye saldırsa da, güç alanı azalmaz. 2. etapta olan bir oyuncu terk edilmiş bir köyü fethetmiş olsa bile, fetih koruması devam eder. Koruma, yalnız ait olduğu köy için geçerliliğini korur; yeni köy başka oyuncular tarafından normal bir şekilde fethedilebilir.
2. etapta olan bir oyuncu, kontlu bir oyuncuya saldırdığı an 2. etap tamamlanmadan iptal edilir, fetih koruması da silinir.
Terkedilmiş köy
 Terk edilmiş köyler korunmuş olmadıklarından dolayı 1:10 üzerinde puana sahip olan oyuncular tarafından da hem saldırıya uğrayabilir hem ele geçirilebilir.

########## TR: villages ##########
class="contentpane" style="min-height: 266px;">
| | Köyler | | Hammaddeler | | Favoriler | 
# Köyler
Kingsage'de temel nokta yerleşim birimleridir. Her yerleşim biriminin haritada kendine ait bir pozisyonu vardır ve koordinatlar ile temsil edilir. Her yerleşim biriminin kendine ait adı ve oyuncusu vardır. Eğer yerleşim birimi herhangi bir oyuncuya sahip değilse terkedilmiş köy olarak nitelendirilir. Eğer oyuncu yerleşim biriminin isminden memnun değilse ismi değiştirebilir.
Her yerleşim oyuncunun belirli aktivitelerini sürdürebilmesi için bazı binalara sahiptir. Kaynaklar üretilir, yerleşimciler hizmete sunulur, asker birimleri üretilir ve araştırılır. Bu yerleşimin savaşmasına ve savunmasına izin verir. Yerleşimlerin gelişmesiyle puanlar ve güç alanı artar. Bu da yerleşimleri güçlendirir ve fethedilmelerini daha zor hale gelir.
## Bonus Köyler
Bazı yerleşimler bonus köy olarak nitelendirilir. Bu köylerin başında, özel yetenekleri olan ve her köye belirli bir bonus veren 'Usta' vardır. Her köy sadece bir bonusa sahip olabilir.
- %10 daha fazla odun
- %10 daha fazla taş
- %10 daha fazla demir
- %10 daha fazla vatandaş
- %10 daha hızlı birlik eğitimi
- %3 daha fazla hammadde üretimi
## Terkedilmiş köy
Dünyanın bazı bölgelerinde terkedilmiş köyler vardır. Bu köyler bir zamanlar hesapları olan ama daha sonra inaktiflik sebebi ile silinen oyunculara aittir. Bu köyler unutulmuşlar ve soyguncular tarafından ele geçirilmişlerdir.
Terkedilmiş köyler normal köyler gibidirler fakat tek farkı oyuncular tarafından değil de soyguncular tarafından kontrol edilirler. Soyguncular köyün gelişimini devam ettirirler, bina inşaa ederler ve askeri birimler oluştururlar ve böylece binanın puanının artmasını sağlarlar.

class="contentpane" style="min-height: 266px;">

# Hammaddeler
Kingsage'te 3 çeşit, kaynak ve aynı zamanda vatandaş mevcuttur. Her ikiside çeşitli mümkün olan aksiyonlar için gereklidirler. Kaynaklar, tüketim maddeleridir ki kullanıldıktan sonra kaybolurlar. Diğer taraftan vatandaşlar ise bazı durumlarla ilişkilidirler (binalar, askeri birimler,...) ve o nesne varolduğu müddetçe vardır.
## Hammaddeler
Tüm eylemler için gerekli 3 adet kaynak mevcuttur. Kaynaklar sürekli olarak bazı binalardan üretilir ve ticareti yapılabilinir marketten alınıp satılabilinir. Buna ek olarak oyuncuların depolarına bağlı olarak depolayabilecekleri maksimum kaynak miktarı mevcuttur.
- [] Odun Oduncu kampında [] üretilir
- [] Taş Taş ocağında [] üretilir
- [] Demir maden ocağında [] üretilir
## Vatandaşlar
Vatandaşlar, oyuncunun aynı zamanda kaynaklarındandır ve oyuncunun mülkiyetini belirlerler. Her bir oyuncunun yerleşim alanı belirli bir miktardır ve böylece bu alanda binalarını inşaa eder ve askerlerini yetiştirir. Her bir obje bu vatandaşlara bağlıdırlar ve bu vatandaşlar daha sonra çalışan vatandaş olarak nitelendirilirler. Hiç bir şeye bağlı olmayanlara da boş vatandaş denir. Eğer bir işlem, oyuncunun sahip olduğu vatandaştan daha fazlasına ihtiyaç duyarsa bu işlem mümkün değildir. Bir köyü geliştirmek için, oyuncu ayrıca değirmeni geliştirmek zorundadır ki bu durum ne kadar vatandaşa sahip olduğunu da gösterir. 
Bir köy oyun akışı esnasında birimlerini ve binalarını kaybetmeye başlar ise çalışan çalışan vatandaşlar tekrar mümkün olacaktır ve diğer işler için kullanılmaya başlanabilirler. Köyü terketmiş vatandaşlar bir savaşta ölene kadar hala köy nüfusunda gözükmektedirler.

class="contentpane" style="min-height: 266px;">
# Harita
Kingsage ara yüzünde bir Harita mevcuttur. Oyuncu haritaya girdiği zaman dünyanın bir bölümünü görebilir. Ve bu şeklinde etrafını saran oyuncular hakkında bilgi sahibi olabilir.
Yerleşim birimleri farklı grafiksek görünüme sahiptir. Tatil modundaki bir hesap gri görüntülenir. Bonus köyler ise parıltılı altın görünümündedir.
Bunun yanında rengarek vurgulanan yerleşimler mevcuttur. Bunun için başlık haritanın alt kenarında yer almaktadır. İttifaklar ve müttefikler gibi. Ayriyetten premium üyeler haritada kendi renklerini oluşturabilirler.
## Miniharita
Haritaya ek olarak oyuncular küçük haritayada giriş yapabilir. Bu sayede dünyanın daha büyük kısmını görülebilinir ve daha net bir bakışa sahip olunur. Renkler farkı yerleşkeleri görüntülemek için kullanılır.
Küçük haritada farklı ayarlar mevcuttur. Bunlardan 2 tanesi herkese açıktır daha fazlasına sahip olabilmek için premium hesaba sahip olunmalıdır.
## Dünya
Kingsage dünyası bütün oyun alanını içermektedir. Bu yapı her sunucuda aynı fakat içeriği farklıdır. Dünya kalıcıdır buda oyuncu artık oyunu oynamasa bile dünyaya verdiği ekti devam edecek anlamına gelmektedir.
Her dünya kıtalara ayrılmış 1,000x1,000 parçacıktan oluşur. 100x100 lük bölüm bir kıtayı temsil eder. Böylece tüm dünya 10x10 kıtadan oluşmaktadır.
## Simyager
Simyacıda bazı teknolojileri araştırabilirsin. Araştırma kaynaklarınıza mal olacaktır fakat size kalıcı bonus verecektir. Çoğu araştırma harita üzerinde etkilidir. Teknoloji bir kez araştırıldığında global hale gelir ve tekrar araştırılmaya ihtiyaç duyulmaz. Bazı teknolojiler harita ayarlarından da aktive edilmelidir.

# Puan
Her köyün, köyün gelişimini de özetleyen, kendine ait belirli bir miktarda puanı vardır. Puanların miktarı aynı zamanda köyün güç alanını da gösterir. Bir köyün güç alanı aynı zamanda bir oyuncunun o yerleşimdeki etkisini de gösterir.
## Köy Puanı
Her binanın puanına her bir gelişim seviyesinde bazı puanlar eklenir. Bu durumda bir köyün yaklaşık güç durumu gösterilmektedir. Puanlar, bina inşaatı bittiğinde hesabınıza hemen eklenirler fakat istatistiklere bu durum hemen yansımaz ki böylece düşmanlarınız da sizin hakkınızda bilgiye ulaşamazlar. Askeri birlikler, savaşlar ve araştırmalar puanınıza etki etmezler. 
Bir oyuncunun toplam puanı aynı zamanda eşdeğer olmayan savaşlarda da seviye belirlemek için kullanılır. Savaş esnasında ayrıca bir moral mekanizması mevcuttur.
## Toplam puan
Oyuncunun sıralamadaki yerini toplam puanları belirler. Genel Saldırı Koruması için de çok önemlidir.
Toplam puanlar, köy puanları ile köy sayısı başına alınan bonus puanlardan oluşur:
Toplam Puan: tüm köy puanları + köy başına 2500 puan (ilki hariç)
## Bina Puanı
Her binanın puanına her bir gelişim seviyesinde bazı puanlar eklenir. Bu durumda bir köyün yaklaşık güç durumu gösterilmektedir. Puanlar, bina inşaatı bittiğinde hesabınıza hemen eklenirler fakat istatistiklere bu durum hemen yansımaz ki böylece düşmanlarınız da sizin hakkınızda bilgiye ulaşamazlar. Askeri birlikler, savaşlar ve araştırmalar puanınıza etki etmezler. 
Bir oyuncunun toplam puanı aynı zamanda eşdeğer olmayan savaşlarda da seviye belirlemek için kullanılır. Savaş esnasında ayrıca bir moral mekanizması mevcuttur.
## Güç Alanı
Bir yerleşimin güç alanı 0 ile köyün puanı arasında değişir. Çünkü bir yerleşimin maksimum puanı hiçbir zaman 10.000 puanı aşamaz buna bağlı olarakta gerçek güç maksimum 10.000'dir. Eğer değer maksimumun altındaysa her saat %1 artış gösterir.
Köyün güç alanı Kont gönderilerek düşürülebilinir. Ve yerleşimin güç alanı 0'a düştüğü an yerleşim saldıranın köyü haline gelir.

# Birimler
Kingsage 'deki birimler araştırılabilir ve eğitilebilir askeri birliklerdir. Her iki aksiyon da kaynak ve nüfusunuzdan bir miktar alır. Eğer oyuncunun birimleri mevcut ise kendini savunabilir veya diğer oyuncularsa saldırabilir veya terkedilmiş yerleşimleri yağmalamak için kullanılabilir. Özel birliklerin ek özellikleri mevcuttur ; mesela casuslar diğer yerleşimlerin özelliklerini ve birimlerini görürler, kontlar da yabancı yerleşimlerin ele geçirilmesinde kullanılır.
## Araştır
Oyuncu birlik üretmeden önce üreteceği birlik tipini araştırmalıdır. Bunun içinde o birliğin ihtiyaç duyduğu tüm şartları yerine getirmeli ve araştırma için gerekli kaynak miktarını barakada ödemelidir. Araştırma süresi baraka nın seviyesi arttıkca azalır.
Kont için durum farklıdır, Kontların barakada araştırmasına gerek yoktur.
Araştırma masrafı ile temel süreleri gösteren bir tablo. Araştırma süresi ayrıyeten kışla seviyesi sayesinde de azalır:

## Eğit
Araştırılmış birlikler barakada doğrudan üretilebilinir. Her birliğin maliyeti farklıdır ve üretim için belli bir süreye ihtiyacı vardır. Zaman bittiğinde oyuncu birliklere sahip olur.
Oyuncu birden fazla sayıda ve çeşitte birlik için üretim emri verebilir. Birlikler emir sırasına göre üretilir. Aşağıdaki tablo birlikler için gereki maliyeti ve süreyi gösterir. Üretim süresi barakanın seviyesi arttıkca azalır.
Kontun buradada bir ayrıcalığı mevcuttur. Kont üretim için altın zırha ihtiyaç duyar ve köşkten üretilebilir. Kontun üretim süresi Köşk'ün seviyesine bağlıdır.

########## TR: units_attack ##########
class="contentpane" style="min-height: 266px;">
| | Birimler | | Emirler | | Destek | | Casusluk | | Fethetmek | | Savaşlar | 
# Emirler
Oyuncu askerlerini baraka vasıtasıyla saldırıya gönderebilir. Kendi ittifak üyelerine ve kendi köylerine saldıramazsın.
Saldırı için aşağıdaki seçenekler mevcuttur:
- Diğer yerleşimlere saldırılar yapabilirsiniz. Savaş, göndermiş olduğunuz askeri birlik köye ulaştığı anda başlayacaktır. 
 - Savaş başarılı olursa kaynaklar talan edilebilinir.
- Kontlar bir asalet ünvanına sahip olabilirler ve başka bir yerleşimi sürekli olacak şekilde zaptedebilirler.
- Casuslar sayesinde hedef köy hakkında daha fazla bilgi edinilebilinir.
- Birliklerinizle kendi arkadaşlarınızın köylerine destek çıkabilirsiniz.
## Saldırı koruması
Oyuncular yerleşimlerini saldırı koruması altına alabilirler. Bu sürede saldırı almazlar. Aşağıdaki koruma seçenekleri mevcuttur:
- 5 Gün Komple Koruma: İlk köy kurulduktan sonraki 5 Gün içerisinde oyuncuya saldırılamaz (herhangi bir rakibe saldırı durumunda koruma kaybedilir)
- Kanun Kaçağı: Tüm köylerin kalıcı bir saldırı koruması altında olur. Senden 10 kat daha yüksek puana sahip oyuncular sana saldıramaz.
Ancak birkaç zayıf oyuncu bir araya gelir ve ordularını birleştirirse, güçlü bir oyuncuya meydan okuyabilir. Uyarı: Bu saldırıyı gerçekleştirirsen kanun kaçağı ilân edilip 2 Aylar boyunca daha güçlü oyunculara karşı 10 : 1 korumanı kaybedersin! 
- Uyku modundaki oyunculara saldırı yapılamaz
## Saldırı Uyarısı
Gelen saldırılar hakkında genel bir bakış elde edebilmek için arayüz sayfasında 2 adet bayrak mevcuttur.Eğer 2 bayrakta açıksa oyuncu doğrudan saldırı alıyor demektir. Eğer sadece sağdaki bayrak açıkca ittifak üyesi saldırı oluyor demektir. Oyuncu açık bayrağa tıklarsa saldırı hakkında genel bakışa ulaşacaktır.
## Talan
Eğer saldıran savaşı kazınırsa o zaman saldıranın birlikleri düşman köyünü yağmalayacaktır. Ve bu kalan birlikler kapasitesi kadar olan kaynakları kendi köylerine götüreceklerdir. Bu kapasite ayriyetten 3 farklı kaynağa bölünecektir: odun, taş, demir. Bir köyün kaynak oluşturma miktarı hiçbir zaman gizli deposundan küçük olamaz.
Kazanan birlikler köye döndüğü an kazanan oyuncu kaynaklarına yağmadan kazandıklarıda eklenecektir.

# Destek
Kendi askerlerinizi dost köyleri savunmak için gönderebilirsiniz. Böylece askerleriniz o köye doğru harekere geçerler. Oraya vardıklarında, başka bir uyarı alana kadar yerleşirler ve köyün savunmasına yardımcı olurlar. Savaş esnasında, köye ait birimler gibi muamele görürler ve köyün surlarından ve anıt bonusundan onlar da yararlanırlar.
Destek esnasında, bu birlikler ait oldukları köydeki nüfusta gözükmeye devam ederler. Ne zaman ki askerler ölmeye başlarlar, o zaman köyünüzdeki nüfusta boşalmalar oluşacaktır.
Eğer bir oyuncu bu destekteki askerleri başka bir köye göndermek istiyorsa, ilk olarak onları geri çekecek daha sonra da yeni hedefe yollayacaktır. Bir köyü savunabilecek asker sayısı konusunda herhangi bir sınırlama söz konusu değildir.
